title: 2023 LLVM Dev Mtg - Mojo 🔥: A system programming language for heterogenous computing
summary: A 2023 LLVM Developers' Meeting keynote by Abdul Dakkak, Chris Lattner and Jeff Niu introducing Mojo, a Python-family systems language built on MLIR and LLVM for heterogeneous computing.
why: HN points to it as the best deep dive into Mojo's design, including MLIR use and SIMD-first scalars.
